title: lichen-core ccp16 desync consumer missed 468ac9cfb4 corpus update: import stripped, pin 4 stale, no synced_missed_beacons consumer
description: Commit 468ac9cfb4 added the 5th corpus case synced_missed_beacons_desync (R-02a-081) and updated the python consumer (EXPECTED_COUNTS CCP16_DESYNC=5) and added the lichen-rpl consumer, but skipped rust/lichen-core/tests/ccp16_desync_vectors.rs: (1) a later clippy cleanup stripped the now-needed use serde_json::Value so the test target no longer compiles at HEAD (uncommitted one-line restore sits in worker3's tree); (2) corpus_case_count_is_pinned asserts 4, corpus has 5 -> corpus_case_count_is_pinned RED; (3) no consumer drive for the new case. Fix: restore import, bump pin to 5, add synced_missed_beacons_desync_vector FSM drive mirroring lichen-rpl/tests/ccp16_desync_vectors.rs (3 on_missed_superframe -> Desynced, counters reset). Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-ba39 lineage via worker3 round startup verification.
close_reason: Fixed in commit 8c1e26b1b5 (worker3): restored use serde_json::Value (test target did not compile at HEAD), bumped corpus pin 4->5, added synced_missed_beacons_desync_vector FSM drive mirroring lichen-rpl/tests/ccp16_desync_vectors.rs (3 on_missed_superframe -> Desynced, missed_superframes+consecutive_valid reset to 0). Reviewer-found P4 fixed in same commit: pin-test comment falsely claimed the C consumer pins the count — corrected to name Python-only pinning (C desync_fsm consumes named cases only). Verification: ccp16 suite 6/6, cargo test -p lichen-core all green, clippy --test ccp16_desync_vectors -D warnings clean, fmt --check clean. 3x kimi-k3 reviewer passes: correctness PASS, security PASS-with-comment (the comment finding), edge-cases PASS-with-comment (same finding); zero logic defects across passes.
